summary.intro: Software engineer with a background in web development who has built hands-on practical experience in 3D modeling and technical drafting. Experienced in creating complete 3D models for FDM and resin (SLA/DLP) 3D printing — from concept to print-ready geometry, accounting for tolerances, wall thickness, and support structures. Produces technical documentation including electrical wiring diagrams and apartment renovation/layout floor plans. Proficient in AutoCAD, Fusion 360, and Autodesk Design Review, with hands-on experience in slicers such as Cura, OrcaSlicer, and Bambu Studio. Brings a software engineer's problem-solving mindset, combined with precision and a solid understanding of additive manufacturing constraints.

items.title: 3D Modeling for FDM & Resin Printing
items.description: Designed 100+ complete, print-ready 3D models for FDM and resin (SLA/DLP) printing, adapting geometry for wall thickness, tolerances, orientation, and support structures to ensure reliable prints.

items.title: Electrical Wiring Diagrams
items.description: Produced detailed electrical wiring diagrams for residential premises, mapping circuits, outlets, and lighting layouts in AutoCAD.

items.title: Apartment Layout & Renovation Drafting
items.description: Created floor plans and renovation/layout redesign drawings for apartments ranging from 40 to 100 m², including wall changes and room reconfiguration, in AutoCAD.

items.title: Design Review & Validation
items.description: Reviewed and annotated 3D models and drawings in Autodesk Design Review to validate designs before finalizing them for print or construction.

achievements.title: Hackathon Contributor
achievements.description: Completed courses on drone management and assembly. Participated in a hackathon focused on developing software for drones.

hobbies.title: 3D Printing & Modeling
hobbies.description: Design and print personal projects on FDM and resin printers; enjoy experimenting with new materials and print settings.
